name: 1688/淘宝/进货返利助手
description:
1688/Taobao/Tmall/Jd/Pdd Purchasing Assistant
Are you still worried about online shopping expenses with the shopping rebate tool?
The "1688/Taobao/Tmall/Jd/Pdd Purchasing Assistant" plugin allows you to easily earn money while shopping!
It covers the five mainstream e-commerce platforms of Alibaba, Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, and Pinduoduo with just one click. Whether you shop daily or purchase in bulk, you can enjoy high rebates on every purchase.
The plugin is easy to operate, runs automatically after installation, and does not require complex settings.
Automatically match hidden coupons before placing an order, overlay rebate discounts, with a maximum rebate ratio of up to 90% of the order amount, truly achieving the goal of making money while buying.
At the same time, real-time tracking of order status, instant receipt of rebate amounts, and clear visibility of profits.
Whether you are a budget conscious lifestyle expert or a bulk purchasing merchant, this plugin is your money saving tool, helping you easily embark on a new experience of online shopping and making money!
